scripts.typecheck: deno check && pnpm -C web typecheck && pnpm -C web build && cargo clippy --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: realm-sdk test && pnpm -C web build && cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.fmt: deno fmt && pnpm -C web fmt && cargo fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
scripts.fmt:check: deno fmt --check && pnpm -C web fmt:check && cargo fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --check
scripts.dev:server: pnpm -C web build && REALMDO_DATA_DIR=./server/data PORT=${REALMDO_PORT:-3000} cargo run --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml
